theme: Dark-first (Obsidian tactical command interface optimized for Desktop & Telegram Web App)
description: Production-ready, security-focused multi-key AI API router control center designed for coding agents (e.g. Cline) with Telegram Bot & Telegram Web App integration.

tech_stack.components: Shadcn/UI primitives customized for dense command center aesthetic

rules.anti_default_rule: Do not use generic sans for headings. Use Outfit or JetBrains Mono for a high-precision, tactical feel.
rules.h1_hero: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-100
rules.h2_section: text-lg sm:text-xl lg:text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-slate-200
rules.code_masked_keys: font-mono tracking-wider text-emerald-400 bg-slate-950/80 px-2.5 py-1 rounded border border-emerald-500/20 text-xs sm:text-sm

rules.no_pure_black: Never use pure #000000; use dark tinted obsidian #080B11 or #0F1523 for surfaces.
rules.contrast: Ensure text contrast meets WCAG AA / APCA standards. Explicitly define hover states text colors e.g. hover:text-white.
rules.no_teal_green_dashboard_ban: Forbidden color #1B93A4 avoided. Palette centers on obsidian, deep navy, slate, cyan and emerald.

layout_and_spacing.mode: MODE B: High Density Command Center Grid

header.style: Fixed / Sticky Glassmorphism Header with z-50
header.title: 🤖 AI ROUTER CONTROL CENTRE
header.system_status_pill: System Online badge with glowing green dot

telegram_web_app_support.viewport_height: use var(--tg-viewport-stable-height, 100vh) or h-screen max-w-7xl mx-auto
telegram_web_app_support.safe_areas: apply px-3 py-2 sm:px-6 sm:py-4 for seamless display in Telegram Mini App web view
telegram_web_app_support.auto_theme_sync: read Telegram.WebApp.themeParams if available, fallback to dark command center theme

elements: Status dot indicator (🟢 Healthy / 🟡 Cooldown / 🔴 Exhausted)
Provider badge (e.g. OpenAI, Anthropic, OpenRouter, DeepSeek, Groq)
Masked Key Value display (e.g. ••••••••A91F or sk-or-v1-••••••••3B2F) with 1-click show/hide toggle
Success rate %, Average latency (ms), Failure count
Cooldown countdown timer (if status is Cooldown)
Action bar: Test Key connection button, Enable/Disable toggle, Change Priority modal/stepper, Delete Key modal

api_key_manager.add_key_modal: Support provider selection, custom endpoint URL, API key input, priority score, weight, rate limit limits.

jobs_session_viewer.grid_layout: Split view: Active/Recent Jobs table on left, Job detail + Failover Step Execution Timeline on right
jobs_session_viewer.step_timeline: Visual vertical timeline showing step 1 (Key A -> 429 Rate Limit) -> step 2 (Failover to Key B -> 200 OK) -> execution duration

widgets: Total requests over time chart (Area chart)
Requests per Provider Key bar chart
Failure & Rate-limit error breakdown pie/bar chart
Latency distribution per provider key table

health_panel.action: Trigger manual health check across all keys

structured_logs_viewer.log_row: Timestamp | Request ID | Provider Key | HTTP Status | Error Class (e.g. RateLimitError, AuthError, Timeout) | Action Taken (Rotated to Key 2) | Duration ms

sections: Routing Strategy (Priority Order, Round Robin, Lowest Latency, Weighted Random)
Failover Rules (Max Retries count, Cooldown duration in seconds, Request timeout in ms, Max Concurrent Jobs)
Health Monitor (Background health check interval sec, auto-heal enabled)
Telegram Bot & Alerts (Bot token, Telegram Chat ID, notify on key failure/cooldown/exhausted)

client_keys_manager.description: Router Client API Keys issued for agents like Cline, Roo Code, Cursor.

testing_and_data_testids.rule: ALL interactive components and critical data displays MUST include clear kebab-case data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all components are strictly written as React JavaScript (.js / .jsx) files.
Do NOT create TypeScript .tsx files as per codebase convention.
Ensure AES-256-GCM encryption semantics are communicated on backend and keys are always masked in frontend UI.
Double check all data-testid attributes are added for full end-to-end automated testing.
Provide interactive mock actions (Test Key, Rotate Key, Add Key, Run Health Check, Simulate Failover Job) with realistic live state updates & Sonner toasts.
Make the UI fully responsive so it looks like a high-end desktop command center while scaling smoothly into Telegram Web App webview windows.
